pack.title: Hotel Front Office — Mandarin
pack.description: Polite Mandarin (Mainland) phrases for front desk staff serving hotel guests.
pack.generated_by: Qonverse sample pack (please have a native speaker review before real use)

scenarios.title: Check-in
scenarios.context: Greeting arriving guests and finding their booking.

in_a_sentence.text: 请问您预订的名字是什么？
in_a_sentence.romanization: Qǐngwèn nín yùdìng de míngzi shì shénme?
in_a_sentence.meaning: May I ask the name on your booking?

phrases.when_to_use: When a guest arrives to check in and you need to find their reservation.
phrases.notes: 请问 (qǐngwèn, 'may I ask') makes a question polite.

example.setting: A guest walks up to the front desk with a suitcase.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 您好，欢迎光临。请问您预订的名字是什么？
dialogue.romanization: Nín hǎo, huānyíng guānglín. Qǐngwèn nín yùdìng de míngzi shì shénme?
dialogue.meaning: Hello, welcome. May I ask the name on your booking?

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.romanization: Hǎo de, Wáng xiānsheng, qǐng shāo děng.
dialogue.meaning: Okay, Mr Wang, one moment please.

likely_responses.romanization: Shì yòng gōngsī míngzi dìng de.
likely_responses.meaning: It was booked under the company name.

in_a_sentence.romanization: Wǒ bāng nín chá yíxià, qǐng shāo děng.
in_a_sentence.meaning: Let me check for you, one moment please.

phrases.when_to_use: Any time you need the guest to wait briefly.

example.setting: You are searching for the guest's reservation.

dialogue.speaker: guest
dialogue.meaning: I have a booking, surname Li.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 好的，我帮您查一下，请稍等。
dialogue.romanization: Hǎo de, wǒ bāng nín chá yíxià, qǐng shāo děng.
dialogue.meaning: Okay, let me check for you, one moment please.

in_a_sentence.meaning: Could you please show your passport?

phrases.notes: 麻烦您 (máfan nín) is a polite way to ask a favour.

example.setting: You have found the booking and need to register the guest.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.meaning: Could you please show your passport?

in_a_sentence.text: 早餐时间是七点到十点。
in_a_sentence.romanization: Zǎocān shíjiān shì qī diǎn dào shí diǎn.

phrases.when_to_use: When a guest asks about breakfast.

example.setting: A guest asks about breakfast while you hand over the room card.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 早餐时间是七点到十点，在二楼。
dialogue.romanization: Zǎocān shíjiān shì qī diǎn dào shí diǎn, zài èr lóu.
dialogue.meaning: Breakfast is from 7 to 10, on the 2nd floor.

likely_responses.meaning: Is it included in the room rate?

scenarios.title: Check-out
scenarios.context: Settling the bill and saying goodbye.

phrases.when_to_use: When a guest comes to the desk with luggage in the morning.
phrases.notes: Room numbers are read digit by digit, and 1 is said yāo.

example.setting: A guest puts their room card on the counter.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.romanization: Nín hǎo, nín shì yào tuìfáng ma?

dialogue.speaker: guest
dialogue.romanization: Duì, yāo èr líng bā fáng.

in_a_sentence.text: 请问您刷卡还是付现金？
in_a_sentence.romanization: Qǐngwèn nín shuākǎ háishi fù xiànjīn?
in_a_sentence.meaning: Will you pay by card or cash?

phrases.when_to_use: After showing the bill, to ask how the guest will pay.

example.setting: The guest has checked the bill.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.text: 一共是一千二百元。请问您刷卡还是付现金？
dialogue.romanization: Yígòng shì yìqiān èrbǎi yuán. Qǐngwèn nín shuākǎ háishi fù xiànjīn?
dialogue.meaning: The total is 1,200 yuan. Card or cash?

in_a_sentence.romanization: Xūyào bāng nín jìcún xíngli ma?
in_a_sentence.meaning: Would you like us to store your luggage?

phrases.when_to_use: When a checked-out guest still has time before leaving.

example.setting: The guest says their flight is in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: guest
dialogue.romanization: Wǒ de hángbān shì wǎnshang de.
dialogue.meaning: My flight is in the evening.

dialogue.speaker: you
dialogue.romanization: Xūyào bāng nín jìcún xíngli ma?
dialogue.meaning: Would you like us to store your luggage?

likely_responses.meaning: Until what time can I leave it?

in_a_sentence.text: 谢谢您的入住，欢迎再次光临！
in_a_sentence.romanization: Xièxie nín de rùzhù, huānyíng zàicì guānglín!
in_a_sentence.meaning: Thank you for staying with us, please come again!

phrases.when_to_use: The standard farewell as the guest leaves.
